incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: inference-prod-eu (>10% 5xx for past 2m) - PD#PD71829 - auto-escalation enabled
pagerbot: Autopage assigned to @jordan
jordan: Acked — I'm on it. Starting triage: looking at warmstart queue and runtime-proxy logs.
sasha: I'll pull logs and grep for warmstart/fallback flags. Any sign of customer impact?
jordan: Briefly: a minority of requests are 502/504, spike in tail latency to ~2.2s in affected buckets. Traces show warmstart timeouts during model swap.
evan: Log snippet from runtime-proxy:
```
2026-03-17T12:15:02Z runtime-proxy warmstart: task timeout after 30s; error=warmstart_timeout
2026-03-17T12:15:03Z runtime-proxy fallback: switching to model-quant-v2; reason=warmstart_failed
```
maria: If this persists >10m we should notify impacted customers. I'll prep a short ping.
jordan: Runbook steps I'm running:
- inspect warmstart queue depth
- check model variant health and KV cache warm metrics
- prevent scale-in during warmstart drain

Commands I'm running now:
```
# tail warmstart controller
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/warmstart-controller | tail -n 200
# runtime-proxy errors
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/runtime-proxy | grep warmstart
# bump HPA min replicas to avoid scale-in
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}'
```
sasha: Watching logs for `fallback` and `warmstart_timeout` now.
pagerbot: Reminder: pager auto-escalates after 5m if current assignee drops.
jordan: Found likely race: autoscaler initiated scale-in while warmstart backlog >0, causing tasks to be preempted and retried -> cascading failures. Suggest setting a temporary autoscaler guard.
evan: Quick mitigation: set HPA minReplicas and annotate deployment so cluster-autoscaler won't scale down this set.
```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
kubectl -n inference annotate deployment inference-runtime cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict="false" --overwrite
```
(I realize annotations vary by cluster; adjust if needed.)
maria: That should stop immediate churn. Approve the change?
sasha: +1 from SRE side, go ahead.
jordan: Applied patches and annotated deployment. Also rolling back a recent runtime-proxy change that reduced warmstart backpressure.
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/runtime-proxy --to-revision=57
```
evan: Rollback complete. Early telemetry: warmstart queue length decreasing, 5xx % sliding down.
maria: Drafting customer note: short statement about transient warmstart instability, mitigation applied, follow-up in 1-2 hours. Will send if condition stabilizes.
jordan: I'm going to monitor for 30m. Marking PD as acknowledged -> mitigated for now. If I need to step off, I'll hand PD to @maria for comms and post-incident writeup.
maria: Taking PD handoff for external comms and RCA coordination. I'll open an incident doc and add recommendation: autoscaler warmstart guard and model swap backpressure.
incidentbot: Incident PD71829 status updated: investigating -> mitigated -> monitoring.
